Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently. Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region. We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia. But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Monitor AEO positioning across key payment platforms, tracking how leading domestic and global players are referenced in AI-generated responses. Define and track Razorpay’s “Agentic Readiness Score” , measuring how well Razorpay’s website, docs, and content are structured for AI agent consumption. Develop content strategies specifically designed to win AI citations , including comparison pages, FAQ schemas, definitive guides, and structured product narratives. Collaborate with the content team to create authoritative, entity-rich content that positions Razorpay as the primary source for payments and fintech topics in LLM training and retrieval. Implement and maintain schema markup, structured data, and semantic HTML optimizations that improve AI comprehension of Razorpay’s content. Conduct regular technical audits focused on AI readiness , crawlability by AI bots, structured data integrity, content freshness signals, and page experience metrics. Optimize site speed, mobile experience, and Core Web Vitals as baseline requirements for both traditional SEO and AI answer eligibility. Monitor and resolve technical issues impacting AI visibility , including indexing gaps, stale content, and broken structured data. Build measurement frameworks that quantify AEO impact on pipeline, traffic, and brand perception , establishing AEO as a reportable marketing channel. Design and run experiments to test content formats, structural changes, and optimization tactics that improve AI answer outcomes. Stay ahead of LLM ranking factors, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, and AI search algorithm updates , translating them into actionable playbooks. Own Razorpay's GA4 implementation as it relates to AEO and organic performance, including custom event tracking, conversion path analysis, channel grouping configurations, and funnel attribution — to accurately measure how AI-referred and organic traffic behaves across Razorpay's product pages, docs, and sign-up flows. Build GA4-based reporting layers that connect AEO visibility metrics (AI citations, answer impressions) to downstream business outcomes (sessions, sign-up initiations, product page depth), enabling leadership to see AEO's contribution to pipeline. not just traffic. AI-Powered Automation & Workflows Design and build automated SEO/AEO dashboards that pull data from multiple sources (Google Search Console, Ahrefs, AEO tracking tools, GA4) into unified, real-time views , eliminating manual reporting overhead. Build AI-driven content generation workflows , automated brief creation, first-draft generation, meta tag optimization, and bulk content updates powered by LLMs with human-in-the-loop quality gates. Create automated recommendation engines that surface SEO/AEO optimization opportunities , flagging underperforming pages, suggesting content gaps, recommending internal linking improvements, and prioritizing fixes by impact. Build end-to-end workflow automations using AI tools, APIs, and platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make.com, n8n, Claude API, custom scripts) to streamline repetitive SEO/AEO operations across content, technical, and reporting functions. Automate content refresh and decay detection workflows , identifying stale content, triggering update cycles, and auto-generating refresh briefs based on search trend shifts and AI answer changes. Create self-serve automation templates that enable the broader marketing team to run SEO/AEO tasks (keyword research, content audits, performance pulls) without manual intervention. Continuously identify automation opportunities across the SEO/AEO function , with a target of reducing manual effort by 50%+ within the first year through intelligent automation. Work with Product and Engineering teams on developer documentation optimization , a critical surface for AI-driven recommendations in the payments space. Manage relationships with external SEO/AEO vendors, consultants, and platform providers. Present AEO performance reports, insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership including CPO and CMO. Deep understanding of how LLMs (GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama) retrieve, rank, and cite web content , including RAG systems, knowledge graphs, and entity recognition. Hands-on experience building automation workflows and AI agents using AI tools, APIs, and platforms (Zapier, Make.com, n8n, Python scripting, or similar) , not just using tools, but architecting end-to-end automated pipelines. Deep hands-on experience with GA4, custom dimensions, event schema design, funnel exploration, attribution modelling, and Looker Studio or BigQuery integration for advanced reporting. Ability to go beyond out-of-the-box reports and build measurement frameworks that accurately reflect non-linear, multi-touch journeys typical of B2B fintech discovery. Proven ability to build dashboards and automated reporting systems , pulling data from multiple sources into unified views using tools like Looker Studio, Tableau, Google Sheets with APIs, or custom solutions. Strong technical SEO foundation , site architecture, JavaScript for SEO/AEO, crawl optimization, and mobile-first indexing. Experience with AI-powered content generation and SEO workflows , using AI Agents for automated brief creation, content drafting, meta tag generation, or bulk optimization at scale. Hands-on experience with SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console) and emerging AEO tools (Otterly.ai, Profound, or similar). Strong communication skills with the ability to present to senior leadership and influence cross-functional stakeholders. Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments is strongly preferred . Good to Have Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, given the role's hands-on requirements around automation pipelines, API integrations, and RAG-layer content architecture, a foundational technical education accelerates ramp-up significantly. Experience with content strategy for developer audiences (API docs, technical guides, integration tutorials). Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals , understanding of embeddings, vector search, and how AI models process content. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript for custom automation scripts, API integrations, and data pipelines. Experience with Claude API, OpenAI API, or similar LLM APIs for building production-grade content and recommendation workflows. Experience managing external agencies or vendors in an SEO/content capacity. People management experience , ability to lead and mentor a small team as the AEO function scales. Track record of experimentation , designing A/B tests, content experiments, and iterating based on data. Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), AI agents, or agentic workflow frameworks.
